title: ProductEffectiveness
description: ISO 25010-sourced quality archetype — Effectiveness quality-in-use characteristic. Measures the accuracy and completeness with which users achieve specified goals. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms. Source: ISO/IEC 25010 (Quality in Use — Effectiveness).

taskCompletionRate.description: Percentage of tasks completed successfully by users (0-100).

goalAchievementAccuracy.description: Percentage of goals achieved with the specified accuracy (0-100).

errorFrequency.description: Frequency of user errors preventing goal achievement.
